tooltip.mark_wand.line1: Right-click a container: mark / unmark a material chest (its GUI stays closed)
tooltip.mark_wand.line2: Right-click a non-container (dirt/stone): red action-bar hint, nothing else happens
tooltip.mark_wand.line3: Shift+right-click twice: box-select up to %s containers as material chests
tooltip.mark_wand.line4: Shift+left-click a container: mark / unmark an output (overflow) chest
key.schematic_restock.build: Auto-Build: start / pause (hold V + this key)
hud.outputs_none: Output chests: %s / %s (none marked; overflow goes to backpack/limbo)
hud.validate: Re-check: %s removed items re-added to the shortfall
chat.take_started: [Restock] Started, raw shortfall of %s kinds (the server first deducts what you already carry)…
chat.take_started_hold: [Restock] Started, raw shortfall of %s kinds (the server first deducts what you already carry); building paused itself out of the way and resumes when this ends…
chat.wand_anchor: Box corner A noted. Shift+right-click the opposite corner (up to %s containers per go)
chat.wand_not_container: That block is not a container - cannot mark it
chat.wand_not_container_output: That block is not a container - cannot mark it as an output chest
noop.still_enough: No shortfall after the re-check - the marked chests are probably truly short
noop.not_found: No Forgematica shortfall detected - load a schematic / check the bridge first
noop.uploading: Build plan still uploading - press V+M after this batch lands
noop.enough_validated: Nothing missing right now (%s taken items re-counted, still enough)
chat.build.uploading: [Build] Plan uploading, %s chunks left (starts on its own when done; V+Y cancels)
chat.build.hold_restock: [Build] Restock is running, building resumes on its own afterwards (no need for V+U)
chat.build.takeover_busy: [Build] Restock Takeover is moving items into your pack - wait for it to finish
chat.build.planned: [Build] Plan: %s cells / %s states%s%s, uploading in %s chunks (~%s s)…
chat.build.cancel_upload: [Build] Upload cancelled (nothing had started, no blocks placed)
chat.build.none_active: [Build] No build is running (V+U starts / pauses)
chat.build.be_note: %s of them are chests/signs-like: placed as empty shells (schematic NBT is never copied)
chat.build.missing_item: %s still short %s blocks (press V+M to restock; building resumes by itself)
note.build.no_reply: No reply from the server (world switched / logged out / server missing the same jar?)
note.validated: Shortfall ledger re-check: %s kinds / %s items left the backpack, shortfall re-counted%s: %s
note.validated_kept: (%s more items kept credited as 'already built into walls')
cmd.ghostlog.on: Ghost-craft debug log: ON (written to logs/latest.log, search matfill/ghost)
cmd.ghostlog.strict_on: Strict product-component check: ON (mismatched components fail as UNSAFE_RECIPE)
cmd.ghostlog.strict_off: Strict product-component check: OFF (log only, no verdicts)
cmd.ghostlog.strict_state: Strict product-component check: %s (toggle with /ghostlog strict on|off)
cmd.ghostlog.reset: Recipe index invalidated, the next takeover rebuilds it
cmd.matfill.simulate: Test shortfall injected: 3 kinds (137 planks / 256 cobble / 66 iron). Try V+M
cmd.matfill.keys: Keys: main=%s + hold V | grab=%s%s | Curios=%s
cmd.matfill.marks: Marks: material %s/%s · output %s/%s (clearing removes both kinds)
cmd.matfill.marks_pending: Marks: material %s/%s · output %s/%s (server has not synced yet: rejoin or click once to see)
cmd.matfill.build_server: server: %s | reach gate %s blocks | throttle %s blocks/tick
cmd.matfill.build_help: subcommands: start / cancel / replace air|soft|all / fluids on|off (in-game: hold V then U or Y)
cmd.matfill.policy_now: replace policy = %s (air=only air · soft=+vanilla-replaceable like grass/snow/water · all=overwrite on mismatch)
cmd.matfill.fluids_on_desc: placed (queued last, dead water stays put)
cmd.matfill.policy_next_old: (the uploaded plan keeps the old policy; applies to the next plan)
cmd.matfill.fluids_set_on: [Build] Fluids will be placed (after every solid)
